steps.label: 4. Refit
steps.sub: Retrain the winner on all the data

code:
param_grid = {
    "n_estimators": [50, 200],
    "max_depth": [3, 6, None],
    "min_samples_leaf": [1, 5]}
gs = GridSearchCV(rf, param_grid,
    cv=cv, scoring="f1")
gs.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
caption: rf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42). 12 combos x 5 folds = 60 fits.

code:
gs.best_params_
# {'max_depth': None,

gs.best_score_      # 0.917
gs.best_estimator_  # already refit
gs.predict(X_te)    # uses the best
# test F1: 0.918

steps.label: SPREAD

code:
pipe = Pipeline([
    ("scale", StandardScaler()),
    ("clf", LogisticRegression())])
grid = {"clf__C": [0.01, 0.1, 1, 10]}
gs = GridSearchCV(pipe, grid, cv=cv,
    scoring="f1", n_jobs=-1)
gs.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
# best: {'clf__C': 1}  f1 0.73
caption: The scaler is refit inside every fold. No leakage.
